label: lem:antiderivatives_diff_constant
title: Two antiderivatives differ by a constant
statement: If $a \le b$ and $F, G$ are both continuous antiderivatives of $f$ on $(a,b)$, then $(F - G)(x) = (F - G)(a)$ for all $x \in [a,b]$.
proof: Lemma~\ref{lem:antideriv_diff_zero_deriv} gives zero derivative; Lemma~\ref{lem:zero_deriv_constant} gives constancy.
